data.summary: Players share a bet from two places: a Share icon next to My Bets on the "Bets placed" screen, and a Share button next to Print in Bet History. Both open the same compact share step: the bet card with stake and payout always shown, plus X, Telegram, WhatsApp, Save image, and a Copy link that carries the player's RAF code. On mobile the phone's own share sheet opens first. A friend who opens the link lands on a public bet page with one action, Add to betslip.

The proposal for sharing a bet is in the chat: Share sits next to My Bets on "Bets placed" and next to Print in Bet History, and a friend lands on a public bet page with Add to betslip. I need your direction, plus one call on whether Add to betslip uses today's odds when they've moved.

**Taste ledger**
- 👍/👎 on this project: you chose to always show stake and payout on the card (I'd suggested off by default); you agreed to put the RAF code on the link and to build the public page.
- Strongest rules applied: one primary action with Share as an icon button; keep it simple and compact; no confetti or sound on Copy; the success screen is unchanged apart from the Share icon.

data.summary: Revised per your pin: there's no landing page any more. The shared link opens the sportsbook for that bet's sport, with the picks already in an open betslip ready for a stake. Logged-out friends only see Join when they tap Place. Sharing stays the same: a Share icon next to My Bets on "Bets placed", and Share next to Print in Bet History. Both open the compact card with stake and payout, X / Telegram / WhatsApp / Save image, and a Copy link that carries the RAF code.
